procedure_description: Right total knee arthroplasty (pre-service prior authorization)

stated_denial_reason: Insufficient documentation of conservative therapy: the request referenced prior physical therapy, but no PT notes documenting dates, frequency, duration or response were provided, so Criterion 3 of MP-ORTHO-031 could not be confirmed.

denial_codes.description: Clinical criteria not met / insufficient documentation

appeal_submission_method: Summit Health Plan Appeals Unit, PO Box 4410, Lakemont, ST 00000; fax (555) 010-4480; or provider portal (Appeals > New pre-service appeal). Peer-to-peer available within 14 days at (555) 010-4400.
summary: Pre-service prior authorization for a right TKA (27447-RT) was denied because PT documentation was not included with the request. The Northgate PT discharge summary and injection notes exist in the chart but were not sent.
